title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Two Photometric Intensity Levels (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `img_intensity2` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Tests photometric amplitude fidelity rather than spatial position: a centered 4x4 square must be generated at both target brightnesses (0.35 and 0.85) with tight template RMSE (<= 0.06).
failure_mode: Trainers collapse to a single intermediate gray level (~0.60) or drop the dimmer/brighter mode entirely.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `img_intensity2` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
